name: The Banjo of Ol' Jericho Sticks

source.note: Fabled Heirloom from the Fields of the Crow; the book's numbers, our words.

summary: A banjo that grows with its bearer: spell attacks and save DCs up by +1, +2 at level 7, +3 at 13; Charm Monster once a dusk. Its dance, trapping and charm through a demon's immunity wait on the engine's custom item powers.
